scope_statement: This requirement list covers only the Phase 3B capability test for replacing Phase 2 greybox visual roles with prototype-grade review candidates. It is not a full game asset inventory.
count_rationale: Phase 2's playable greybox has five review-relevant visual roles: player, floor/platform, obstacle/blocker, goal marker, and timer. Phase 3B validates Art Agent production and handoff capability against those roles only. This count is sufficient for the capability slice, not for a full production game.

required_assets.purpose: Represent the controllable player body from the Phase 2 greybox.
required_assets.review_need: BK must be able to judge whether the player reads as controllable and does not imply attack, dash, weapon, aim, or final character identity.
required_assets.implementation_need: Later Implementation can assess whether visual bounds can align with the existing player collision body.

required_assets.purpose: Represent solid standing surfaces from the Phase 2 greybox.
required_assets.review_need: BK must be able to judge whether the surface reads as solid and distinct from background, obstacle, and goal.
required_assets.implementation_need: Later Implementation can assess crop/tile extraction and visual-to-collision alignment.

required_assets.purpose: Represent static blockers or route constraints from the Phase 2 greybox.
required_assets.review_need: BK must be able to judge whether the obstacle reads as a blocker without implying enemy, trap, damage, collectible, or item behavior.
required_assets.implementation_need: Later Implementation can assess whether the visual bounds can align with existing blocker collision.

required_assets.purpose: Represent the right-side destination from the Phase 2 greybox.
required_assets.review_need: BK must be able to judge whether the goal reads as a destination and is not confused with obstacle, item, or reward object.
required_assets.implementation_need: Later Implementation can assess whether the visual marker can remain separate from the trigger area.

required_assets.purpose: Represent the existing time-pressure signal from the Phase 2 greybox.
required_assets.review_need: BK must be able to judge whether the timer visual communicates time pressure without becoming score, ranking, or polished HUD scope.
required_assets.implementation_need: Later Implementation should treat this as visual reference unless a UI-specific Work Package authorizes HUD integration.

reviewability_rule: Every required_asset_id must map to at least one candidate_id and at least one individual candidate file. Contact sheets may be included only as supplementary evidence, not as the primary review unit.
csv_management_rule: For prototype scale, this JSON file may remain the structured source for agents. For production-scale or massive asset review, maintain the human-editable CSV table so BK or a human reviewer can inspect, sort, filter, and directly edit required assets without hand-editing nested JSON.
